title: 第11章 爆发出手五年功力第12章 灭杀试探
slug: 镇守魔教圣女我一天涨一年功力
lines: 天牢的动静自然不可能听不见，陈然看了一眼面前的面板。
“时间差不多了。”
【今日结算】
【身处天牢，煞气侵蚀（豁免）】
【存活一天，奖励：一年功力】
【累计功力：25年】
轰！
一股热流凭空而生，汇入丹田。
陈然握了握拳，空气在掌心被捏爆，发出一声脆响。
“杀啊！”
“宰了这个狗狱卒！”
“抢钥匙！放人！”
走廊尽头，几个满脸横肉的囚犯挥舞着夺来的兵器，狞笑着冲了过来。
为首一人，是个光头大汉，绰号“黑狼”，因杀人越货被捕，一身蛮力惊人。
在他身后，跟着“独眼”彪子和“疯狗”强，都是丁字号里出了名的狠角色。
他们虽然被废了武功，但在天牢里憋了这么久，那股凶性反而更胜往昔。
此刻看到落单的陈然，就像是看到了待宰的羔羊。
“小子，下辈子投胎，记得别当狱卒！”
黑狼怒吼一声，手中的朴刀带着呼啸的风声，狠狠劈向陈然的脑袋。
这一刀，势大力沉。
若是普通人，恐怕会被直接劈成两半。
七号房内。
江梦璃听着外面的喊杀声，眉头微蹙。
“这么快就动手了？”
“那个小狱卒，怕是凶多吉少了。”
她虽然看不上陈然，但也不希望他死在这些杂碎手里。
毕竟，这小子说话虽然气人，但好歹还算有趣。
可惜了。
江梦璃叹了口气，闭上眼睛，不忍去听接下来的惨叫声。
然而。
预想中的惨叫声并没有响起。
取而代之的，是一声沉闷的爆响。
走廊里。
陈然看着冲来的几人，他站在原地，一步未退。
只是在朴刀即将临身的瞬间，脚下轻轻一错。
《云水步》！
content_en:
It was naturally impossible not to hear the movement in the Tianlao. Chen Ran glanced at the panel in front of him.
"It's almost time."
【Today's Settlement】
[Being in a heavenly prison, corroded by evil spirits (exemption)]
[Survive for one day, reward: one year of skill]
[Cumulative skill: 25 years]
Boom!
A stream of heat emerged out of thin air and flowed into Dantian.
Chen Ran clenched his fist, and the air was crushed in his palm, making a crisp sound.
"Kill!"
"Kill this dog jailer!"
"Grab the key! Let him go!"
At the end of the corridor, several prisoners with sinister faces rushed over, waving their stolen weapons and grinning.
The leader was a bald man, nicknamed "Black Wolf". He was arrested for killing people and selling goods, and he had amazing brute strength.
Behind him were "One-Eyed" Biaozi and "Mad Dog" Qiang, both of whom were notoriously ruthless characters in the T-shape.
Although their martial arts were disabled, their ferocity became stronger than before after being held in the prison for so long.
Seeing Chen Ran alone at this moment was like seeing a lamb waiting to be slaughtered.
"Boy, in your next life, remember not to be a jailer!"
Hei Lang roared angrily, and with the whistling wind, the sword in his hand struck Chen Ran's head hard.
This sword is powerful and heavy.
If he were an ordinary person, he would probably be split in half.
In room seven.
Jiang Mengli frowned slightly as she listened to the shouts of killing outside.
"Are you taking action so soon?"
"That little jailer is probably in grave danger."
Although she despises Chen Ran, she doesn't want him to die in the hands of these bastards.
After all, although this kid's words are irritating, they are still interesting.
What a pity.
Jiang Mengli sighed and closed her eyes, unable to bear to hear the screams that followed.
However.
The expected screams did not sound.
Instead, there was a dull explosion.
"Bang!"
in the corridor.
Chen Ran looked at the people rushing towards him. He stood there without taking a step back.
Just when Pu Dao was about to approach, his foot slipped slightly.
"Cloud Water Step"!
